Volume 5 is the fifth and final volume of the Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon! manga.

==Publications==
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Get 1: A Grand, Mid-air Battle with a Rival!
Get 2: Hunting a Big One in the Desert!
Get 3: Who'll Get Swinub-chan?

Get 9: Goodbye, Pikachu!?

Special Get 2: My First Kiss is a Lovely Kiss!?
